D.policy: Fixed longest digitized visible-contour Feret major-axis length. Not a trustworthy maximum over all photographed beads: only16 uncertain contours exist. Each endpoint may move3px, giving conservative ±6px length uncertainty; not a confidence interval. No model size or pixel area determines D.

correspondence.finding: No verified connected physical-owner sequence supports unwrapping or an integer indexing diagnosis. Shared response curves and matched/missing controls quantify aliasing, not physical identity recovery.
correspondence.tested: Full-cycle phase, registration, turn and count±1/±13 probes for2405 and2733 families; signed circuit residuals, conditional wrapped phase proxies and fixed-owner controls.

ablation_findings.policy: Fitted globals unchanged; set only three height geometry coefficients to zero. Read-only, no reoptimization.
Fitted globals unchanged; set only three height geometry coefficients to zero. Read-only, no reoptimization.

height.finding: Global laws are evaluated across both sides and complete physical geometry. Different limbs and conditional owners prevent identifying a unique physical-versus-projection explanation from a slope alone.
height.tested: Same-height left/right photo-half residual bins; global minor-radius gradient, linear/quadratic orientation, camera perspective and one finite shared light.

numerics.finding: Smooth intensity overlap does not make visibility smooth: phase and height-tilt derivatives disagree across scales. Discontinuous branches use bounded coordinate brackets, rejecting unreliable Jacobian steps.
numerics.tested: Original/compiled trace and finite-light shadow agreement, exact versus unthresholded intensity, two finite-difference scales, native/half-pixel sampling and threshold0.25/0.5/0.75.

objective.finding: Individual outcome gains do not constitute whole-photo acceptance; exact maxima, missingness, all components and geography control acceptance.
objective.tested: Four globally applied objectives with the same shared pool and equal remaining time; normalized L2 plus fourth-moment tail.

physical.method: R280 analytic filled-envelope support, affinely transformed for axial thickness. Inconclusive is not collision.
